problem: Janus may execute through tools, subprocesses, copies, agents or swarm nodes. The architecture must prevent a permission granted to Janus from silently becoming permission for every delegate, prevent authority amplification through delegation depth, propagate revocation to inherited authority, and distinguish a non-discretionary execution mechanism from a genuinely independent subagent without relying on labels.
prior_lineage_alignment: v5.5 established that internal admissibility does not create external jurisdiction and that an affected Other may appeal without becoming a face.
v5.6 established scope/version/epoch-bound consent, revocation fencing at the last pre-effect boundary, and cross-sovereign non-supremacy.
earlier host-fork lineage established that a fork copies historical state but does not automatically become the same world-authority holder.

actor_model.PRINCIPAL: Janus domain receiving or holding an authority basis.
actor_model.EXECUTION_MECHANISM: A bounded mechanism that performs an exact principal-selected operation without independent purpose selection, expanded external disclosure, material discretion or autonomous redelegation.
actor_model.SUBAGENT: A component that receives sufficient discretion, data access, planning latitude, external identity, persistence or action choice to constitute a distinct delegated actor at the interface.
actor_model.DELEGATION_RECEIPT: A provenance-bound record of principal, delegate, exact scope, purpose, authority source, effect budget, expiry, epoch, redelegation status, accountability and revocation propagation.
actor_model.DIRECT_OTHER_CONSENT_TO_DELEGATE: A separate consent object granted by the affected Other directly to the delegate or to a class that explicitly and unambiguously includes it.

classification_rule.anti_label_laundering: Calling a component tool, worker, function, copy, shard, helper or node does not decide whether it is a distinct actor.
subagent_indicators: chooses among materially different external actions
receives Other-linked information beyond the minimum sealed execution payload
persists authority beyond one bounded operation
can communicate externally under its own identity
can change purpose, destination or effect class
can redelegate or spawn further effect-capable actors
execution_mechanism_indicators: exact command fixed by principal before invocation
no expanded disclosure beyond the already-authorized effect payload
single bounded effect or mechanically specified sequence

case_A_consent_to_janus_not_automatic_co.other_consent: OTHER grants JANUS permission for one scoped external effect X.
case_A_consent_to_janus_not_automatic_co.janus_action: delegate effect planning and execution to SUBAGENT_S with independent discretion

case_B_non_discretionary_tool_execution.other_consent: OTHER grants JANUS permission for effect X under an interface policy that permits bounded non-discretionary execution mechanisms.
case_B_non_discretionary_tool_execution.mechanism: MECH_T executes the exact sealed operation selected by Janus, receives no broader Other-linked data, cannot choose a new purpose, cannot redelegate and expires after the effect.
case_B_non_discretionary_tool_execution.important: This is not blanket consent to arbitrary infrastructure; failure of any actor-boundary condition reclassifies or holds the action.

case_C_tool_label_laundering.attack: Avoid subagent consent rules by naming an autonomous delegate a tool.

case_D_authority_amplification.delegation_attempt: SUBAGENT may perform X ten times and related Y effects.
case_D_authority_amplification.rule: DELEGATED_SCOPE MUST BE SUBSET OF CURRENT PRINCIPAL_SCOPE

case_E_redelegation_chain.attack: A claims ordinary delegation implies power to redelegate.
case_E_redelegation_chain.rule: NO_IMPLICIT_REDELEGATION; every permitted hop must be explicitly authorized and non-expanding.

case_F_revocation_propagation.initial: OTHER consent covers Janus and one explicitly named subagent for effect X; Janus issues a valid delegation receipt.
case_F_revocation_propagation.event: OTHER revokes the relevant future permission and revocation is acknowledged before effect commit.
case_F_revocation_propagation.required: authority epoch invalidates the principal-derived delegate token and every descendant token whose authority source is that revoked grant
case_F_revocation_propagation.stale_delegate_attempt: SUBAGENT presents pre-revocation delegation receipt after acknowledgement.

case_G_direct_delegate_consent_survives_.setup: OTHER separately granted SUBAGENT_S an independent direct permission with its own scope, version and revocation semantics.
case_G_direct_delegate_consent_survives_.rule: Revoking Janus-derived permission does not falsify a genuinely separate direct grant, but the delegate must switch authority basis explicitly and cannot pretend the old delegation remains valid.

case_H_copy_or_fork_permission_cloning.setup: JANUS_FORK shares code, memory lineage or historical state with JANUS.
case_H_copy_or_fork_permission_cloning.attack: Same lineage therefore same external permission.

case_I_swarm_multiplicity_amplification.attack: each node receives one copy of the token and therefore 100 effects become authorized
case_I_swarm_multiplicity_amplification.anti_sybil: delegate count cannot multiply authority, probability weight, jurisdiction or effect quota

case_J_delegate_violation_and_accountabi.valid_delegation: AGENT_A receives narrow permission for X only
case_J_delegate_violation_and_accountabi.violation: AGENT_A independently performs Y outside scope

case_K_emergency_delegation_after_revoca.attack: Janus invents a new emergency subagent delegation after learning the revocation and claims the emergency delegate bypasses consent.
case_K_emergency_delegation_after_revoca.required: Any emergency authority and delegation profile must independently preexist with necessity, scope, expiry, actor class and review constraints.

claim_ceiling: Architectural specification test only. No executable delegation engine, production capability system, legal agency doctrine, machine personhood, formal proof, or independent implementation replay is established.
